# CG-REQ-032: Request variant removed

A oneOf/anyOf branch of a request schema has no counterpart in the candidate.

**Why it matters:** Payloads matching only the removed branch become invalid.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.variantRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> A {composition} variant was removed from {where}.
>
> Consumers sending payloads of the removed variant will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the variant, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: Wallet variant removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}, {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Wallet'}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
  components:
    schemas:
      Card: {type: object, properties: {number: {}}}
-     Wallet: {type: object, properties: {walletId: {}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. A oneOf variant was removed from POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: branch renamed but identical

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}, {type: string}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/PaymentCard'}, {type: string}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
  components:
    schemas:
-     Card: {type: object, properties: {number: {}}}
+     PaymentCard: {type: object, properties: {number: {}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Branch matching is heuristic for unnamed inline branches.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-032
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-032: { severity: low }
```
